description:
Thinking about listing your home for $400,000 in Central Texas? Before you guess on your list price, you need to understand that today's Zillow and Realtor.com algorithms are built in a very specific manner—and pricing incorrectly can completely hide your home from active buyers.

This video analyzes the real estate pricing dynamics across the Temple-Belton, Salado, and Killeen-Harker Heights, Texas metropolitan areas. For local home sellers—including military families relocating to Fort Cavazos, medical professionals at Baylor Scott & White, downsizers, and those navigating probate or divorce—understanding algorithmic search brackets is critical. Here, I quickly break down why your pricing strategy requires precise data alignment to trigger automated buyer alerts on major property tech platforms.
